## R Markdown

# Primary microglial bulk RNA-seq: CXCL14 versus control

This document reproduces the downstream R analysis of HTSeq gene counts from primary mouse microglia treated for 2 hours with CXCL14 or control. Count files were generated from the sequencing workflow described in the manuscript. The analysis here starts from **processed** HTSeq counts, not FASTQ files. Keep count files in `data/primary_counts/` and name them `Con-*.counts.txt` and `CXCL14-*.counts.txt`. Sample identity and experimental design should be verified against the deposited metadata.Raw and processed data deposited on GEO GSE352519. 

## 1. Packages

```{r packages}
library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(apeglm)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(ReactomePA)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(pheatmap)
library(stringr)
library(ggrepel)
library(tibble)
```

## 2. Load HTSeq counts

```{r import}
count_dir <- file.path("data", "primary_counts")
htseq_to_counts <- function(path.dir, file.suffix = ".counts.txt") {
  files <- sort(Sys.glob(file.path(path.dir, paste0("*", file.suffix))))
  if (!length(files)) stop("No HTSeq files found in ", path.dir)
  tables <- lapply(files, function(f) {
    x <- read.table(f, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if (ncol(x) != 2L) stop("Expected two columns in ", f)
    names(x) <- c("gene", "count")
    x
  })
  genes <- tables[[1]]$gene
  if (!all(vapply(tables, function(x) identical(x$gene, genes), logical(1)))) {
    stop("Gene IDs/order differ among count files")
  }
  m <- do.call(cbind, lapply(tables, `[[`, "count"))
  rownames(m) <- genes
  colnames(m) <- sub(paste0("\\Q", file.suffix, "\\E$"), "", basename(files), perl = TRUE)
  m <- m[!grepl("^__", rownames(m)), , drop = FALSE]
  storage.mode(m) <- "integer"
  m
}
count_matrix <- htseq_to_counts(count_dir)
head(count_matrix)
```

## 3. Differential expression with DESeq2

The original workflow used `Con` as reference; genes were kept with counts >= 10 in at least as many samples as the smallest treatment group.

```{r deseq}
condition <- factor(vapply(strsplit(colnames(count_matrix), "-"), `[`, character(1), 1),
                    levels = c("Con", "CXCL14"))
if (anyNA(condition)) stop("Sample names must start Con- or CXCL14-")
coldata <- data.frame(condition = condition, row.names = colnames(count_matrix))
print(table(coldata$condition))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_matrix, colData = coldata,
                              design = ~ condition)
dds$condition <- relevel(dds$condition, ref = "Con")
smallestGroupSize <- min(table(dds$condition))
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= smallestGroupSize
dds <- dds[keep, ]
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "CXCL14", "Con"))
res_shrunk <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = "condition_CXCL14_vs_Con", type = "apeglm")
summary(res)
plotDispEsts(dds)
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "condition")
```

## 4. Map gene identifiers


```{r mapping}
res_df <- as.data.frame(res_shrunk)
res_df$symbol <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = rownames(res_df),
  column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first")
res_df$entrez <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = rownames(res_df),
  column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first")
res_df <- dplyr::select(res_df, symbol, entrez, everything())
head(res_df)
```

## 5. Reactome GSEA 

```{r reactome}
ranks_sig <- sign(res_df$log2FoldChange) * -log10(res_df$pvalue)
names(ranks_sig) <- res_df$entrez
ranks_sig <- ranks_sig[!is.na(names(ranks_sig)) & is.finite(ranks_sig)]
if (anyDuplicated(names(ranks_sig))) {
  warning
}
ranks_sig <- sort(ranks_sig, decreasing = TRUE)
ego_react_sig <- ReactomePA::gsePathway(
  geneList = ranks_sig, organism = "mouse", pvalueCutoff = 1, verbose = TRUE)
resR <- as.data.frame(ego_react_sig@result)
resR$core_list <- strsplit(resR$core_enrichment, "/")

jaccard <- function(a, b) {
  a <- unique(a); b <- unique(b)
  if (!length(a) || !length(b)) return(0)
  length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
}
simplify_jaccard_gsea <- function(df, cutoff = 0.3) {
  df <- df %>% arrange(p.adjust, desc(abs(NES))) %>% mutate(keep = TRUE)
  kept_idx <- integer(0)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
    if (length(kept_idx) && any(vapply(kept_idx, function(k)
       jaccard(df$core_list[[i]], df$core_list[[k]]), numeric(1)) >= cutoff)) {
      df$keep[i] <- FALSE
    } else {
      kept_idx <- c(kept_idx, i)
    }
  }
  df %>% filter(keep) %>% select(-keep)
}
resR_slim <- simplify_jaccard_gsea(resR, cutoff = 0.3)
```

### Figure 4A: top upregulated Reactome pathways

```{r reactome-plot}
##shortening again 
plot_up <- resR_slim %>%
  filter(!is.na(NES), NES > 0) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = NES, n = 10) %>%
  mutate(
    neglog10p = -log10(p.adjust),
    Description = str_to_sentence(Description)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # optional label cleanups
    Description = gsub("\\btype ii\\b", "type II", Description, ignore.case = TRUE),
    Description = gsub("\\bb cell\\b", "B cell", Description, ignore.case = TRUE),
    Description = gsub("^Erad", "ERAD", Description, ignore.case = TRUE),
    Description = gsub("^Er-", "ER–", Description, ignore.case = TRUE),
    Description = gsub("er nucleus", "ER–nucleus", Description, ignore.case = TRUE),
    Description = gsub("^Dna", "DNA", Description),
    Description = gsub("Interferon-alpha", "Interferon-α", Description),
    Description = gsub("Interferon beta", "Interferon-β", Description, ignore.case = TRUE),
    Description = gsub("nf-kappa b", "NF-κB", Description, ignore.case = TRUE),
    Description = gsub("mhc", "MHC", Description, ignore.case = TRUE),
    Description = gsub("\\bMrna\\b", "mRNA", Description),
    Description = gsub("\\bDdx58\\b", "DDX58", Description),
    Description = gsub("\\bifih1\\b", "IFIH1", Description),
    Description = gsub("\\bIsg15\\b", "ISG15", Description),
    Description = gsub("interferon-alpha/beta", "interferon-α/β", Description),
    Description = gsub("\\brna pol ii\\b", "RNA Pol II", Description, ignore.case = TRUE),
    Description = gsub("\\bbcr\\b", "BCR", Description, ignore.case = TRUE),
    Description = gsub("\\bdna synthesis\\b", "DNA synthesis", Description, ignore.case = TRUE),
    Description = gsub("\\s+", " ", Description),

  
    Description = dplyr::case_when(
      Description == "Antigen activates B cell receptor (BCR) leading to generation of second messengers" ~
        "BCR signaling",
      Description == "Regulation of actin dynamics for phagocytic cup formation" ~
        "Phagocytic cup formation",
      TRUE ~ Description
    ),

    # wrap last
    Description = stringr::str_wrap(Description, width = 50)
  ) %>%
  arrange(NES) %>%
  mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = Description))

ggplot(plot_up, aes(x = NES, y = Description, fill = neglog10p)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis",
    name = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value"))
  ) +
  labs(x = "NES", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )


```

## 6. Primary microglia IFN heatmap 

```{r ifn-heatmap}
##heatmap of IFN genes
selected_symbols <- c(
    # sensing / IFI family
  "Ifi203","Ifi204","Ifi205","Ifi207",
  # TFs
  "Stat1","Stat2","Irf3","Irf7",
  # effector ISGs
  "Isg15","Mx1","Oas2","Oas3","Gbp2","Gbp3",

  # negative regulators
  "Usp18","Socs1","Socs2","Parp14"
)


library(DESeq2)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)

# variance-stabilized expression (better than raw normalized counts for heatmaps)
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
mat_all <- assay(vsd)   # genes x samples



sym2ens <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys = selected_symbols,
  column = "ENSEMBL",
  keytype = "SYMBOL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

# keep only genes that mapped + are in your expression matrix
keep_syms <- names(sym2ens)[!is.na(sym2ens) & sym2ens %in% rownames(mat_all)]
sym2ens <- sym2ens[keep_syms]

# subset matrix in the exact order of your selected symbols
mat <- mat_all[sym2ens, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(mat) <- names(sym2ens)  # show SYMBOLs on the heatmap rows


# make sure levels are Con first
dds$condition <- factor(dds$condition, levels = c("Con","CXCL14"))

sample_order <- order(dds$condition)
mat <- mat[, sample_order, drop = FALSE]

# clean colnames like Con-1, Con-2, CXCL14-1...
cond <- dds$condition[sample_order]
colnames(mat) <- paste0(cond, "-", ave(as.character(cond), cond, FUN = seq_along))



anno_col <- data.frame(Condition = cond)
rownames(anno_col) <- colnames(mat)

ann_colors <- list(
  Condition = c(
    "Con"    = "#BDBDBD",  # light neutral gray
    "CXCL14" = "#7FC97F"   # soft light green
  )
)

gap_after_con <- sum(cond == "Con")



pheatmap(
  mat,
  scale = "row",                 # Z-score per gene
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  gaps_col = gap_after_con,
  annotation_col = anno_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  fontsize_row = 18,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  angle_col = 45,
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Type I IFN signature (bulk primary microglia)"
)

```

## 7. Phagocytosis heatmap 

```{r phagocytosis-heatmap}
##phagocytosis heatmap
selected_symbols <- c(
  "Axl","Tyro3","Syk","Vav3","Fcgr1","Lgals9","Lgals3bp","Gpr65",
  "Rab7b","Rab11fip5","Dock8","Arhgef2","Arhgap22","Fgd2",
  "Ctss","Ctsa","Ctsz"
)

library(DESeq2)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)

# 1) VST matrix (do this once per session; if you already have vsd/mat_all, reuse them)
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
mat_all <- assay(vsd)   # genes x samples

# 2) Map SYMBOL -> ENSEMBL (handle missing genes gracefully)
sym2ens <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys = selected_symbols,
  column = "ENSEMBL",
  keytype = "SYMBOL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

# keep only genes that mapped + are in expression matrix
keep_syms <- names(sym2ens)[!is.na(sym2ens) & sym2ens %in% rownames(mat_all)]
sym2ens <- sym2ens[keep_syms]

# subset matrix (in your preferred order)
mat <- mat_all[sym2ens, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(mat) <- names(sym2ens)

# (optional) see what dropped out
setdiff(selected_symbols, rownames(mat))

# 3) Column order: Con first, then CXCL14
dds$condition <- factor(dds$condition, levels = c("Con","CXCL14"))
sample_order <- order(dds$condition)
mat <- mat[, sample_order, drop = FALSE]

cond <- dds$condition[sample_order]
colnames(mat) <- paste0(cond, "-", ave(as.character(cond), cond, FUN = seq_along))

# 4) Annotation bar + colors
anno_col <- data.frame(Condition = cond)
rownames(anno_col) <- colnames(mat)

ann_colors <- list(
  Condition = c(
    "Con"    = "#BDBDBD",
    "CXCL14" = "#7FC97F"
  )
)

gap_after_con <- sum(cond == "Con")

# 5) Heatmap
pheatmap(
  mat,
  scale = "row",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  gaps_col = gap_after_con,
  annotation_col = anno_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  fontsize_row = 18,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  angle_col = 45,
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Phagocytosis / DAP12-adjacent genes (bulk primary microglia)"
)

```

## 8. Reactome GSEA running-enrichment plots (primary microglia)

The following analysis generates running-enrichment (“random walk”) plots for two
Reactome interferon-related pathways in CXCL14-treated primary microglia. The
plots display all pathway-hit ticks, with labels selected by a greedy spacing
algorithm to reduce overlap. The ranking vector `ranks_sig` is generated in the
preceding Reactome GSEA section; it must be a sorted numeric vector named by
mouse Entrez gene IDs.

```{r primary-reactome-running-enrichment, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
# Required packages (may already have been loaded above)
library(dplyr)
library(msigdbr)
library(fgsea)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

# A ranked vector of unique Entrez IDs must have been created earlier.
stopifnot(is.numeric(ranks_sig), !is.null(names(ranks_sig)))
stopifnot(!anyNA(names(ranks_sig)), !anyDuplicated(names(ranks_sig)))
stopifnot(all(is.finite(ranks_sig)))
ranks_sig <- sort(ranks_sig, decreasing = TRUE)

# 8.1. Retrieve mouse Reactome pathway gene sets from MSigDB.
# This uses the msigdbr argument names in the original analysis.
msig_reactome <- msigdbr(
  species = "Mus musculus", category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:REACTOME"
)

reactome_list <- msig_reactome %>%
  filter(!is.na(entrez_gene)) %>%
  group_by(gs_name) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(as.character(unique(entrez_gene))), .groups = "drop")

pathways <- setNames(reactome_list$genes, reactome_list$gs_name)

find_reactome <- function(pattern) {
  hits <- grep(pattern, names(pathways), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (length(hits) == 0) stop("No Reactome pathway matched: ", pattern)
  if (length(hits) > 1) {
    message("Multiple Reactome matches; using first: ", hits[1],
            ". Review all matches: ", paste(hits, collapse = "; "))
  }
  hits[1]
}

pw1_name <- find_reactome("DDX58.*IFIH1|IFIH1.*DDX58|DDX58/IFIH1")
pw2_name <- find_reactome("ISG15.*ANTIVIRAL")
message("Reactome pathway 1: ", pw1_name)
message("Reactome pathway 2: ", pw2_name)

pw1_genes <- pathways[[pw1_name]]
pw2_genes <- pathways[[pw2_name]]

# 8.2. Run GSEA for these two pathways.
set.seed(1)
fg <- fgsea(
  pathways = list(
    "DDX58/IFIH1-mediated induction of IFN-α/β" = pw1_genes,
    "ISG15 antiviral mechanism" = pw2_genes
  ),
  stats = ranks_sig,
  minSize = 10,
  maxSize = 500
)

print(
  dplyr::as_tibble(fg) %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, size, NES, pval, padj) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj)
)

# 8.3. Calculate running enrichment score for positioning labels.
compute_running_es <- function(pathway_genes, ranks_sig) {
  stats <- sort(ranks_sig, decreasing = TRUE)
  hits <- names(stats) %in% pathway_genes
  Nh <- sum(hits)
  Nm <- length(stats) - Nh
  if (Nh == 0 || Nm == 0) stop("Pathway must overlap some, but not all, ranked genes")

  hit_weights <- abs(stats)
  norm_hit <- sum(hit_weights[hits])
  if (norm_hit == 0) stop("All pathway hit weights are zero")

  inc_hit <- ifelse(hits, hit_weights / norm_hit, 0)
  inc_miss <- ifelse(!hits, 1 / Nm, 0)
  data.frame(rank = seq_along(stats), running_es = cumsum(inc_hit - inc_miss))
}

# 8.4. Select high-scoring gene labels with minimum horizontal spacing.
# This changes labels only, not the underlying enrichment curve or all hit ticks.
thin_labels_greedy <- function(df, min_gap = 60, max_labels = 18) {
  df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(rank), !is.na(score), !is.na(symbol)) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(score)))

  kept <- df[0, , drop = FALSE]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
    if (nrow(kept) >= max_labels) break
    r <- df$rank[i]
    if (nrow(kept) == 0 || all(abs(r - kept$rank) >= min_gap)) {
      kept <- bind_rows(kept, df[i, ])
    }
  }
  kept %>% arrange(rank)
}

# 8.5. Plot running enrichment with the original publication label styling.
make_plot_with_thinned_tick_labels <- function(pathway_genes,
                                               pathway_key,
                                               title_text,
                                               fg,
                                               ranks_sig,
                                               label_mode = c("leadingEdge", "allHits"),
                                               min_gap = 60,
                                               max_labels = 18,
                                               label_y_frac = 0.12,
                                               angle = 90,
                                               text_size = 3.0) {
  label_mode <- match.arg(label_mode)
  fg_row <- fg[fg$pathway == pathway_key, ]
  if (nrow(fg_row) != 1) stop("Could not uniquely match pathway: ", pathway_key)

  NES_val <- fg_row$NES[1]
  padj_val <- fg_row$padj[1]
  ranked_entrez <- names(ranks_sig)

  label_entrez <- if (label_mode == "leadingEdge") {
    as.character(fg_row$leadingEdge[[1]])
  } else {
    intersect(as.character(pathway_genes), ranked_entrez)
  }

  lab_df <- data.frame(
    entrez = label_entrez,
    rank = match(label_entrez, ranked_entrez)
  ) %>% filter(!is.na(rank))

  lab_df$symbol <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = lab_df$entrez,
    column = "SYMBOL",
    keytype = "ENTREZID",
    multiVals = "first"
  )

  lab_df <- lab_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(symbol)) %>%
    mutate(score = ranks_sig[match(entrez, names(ranks_sig))])

  lab_df_thin <- thin_labels_greedy(
    lab_df, min_gap = min_gap, max_labels = max_labels
  )

  es_df <- compute_running_es(pathway_genes, ranks_sig)
  label_y <- max(es_df$running_es, na.rm = TRUE) * label_y_frac

  # plotEnrichment draws the full running curve and every pathway-hit tick.
  fgsea::plotEnrichment(pathway_genes, ranks_sig) +
    ggtitle(paste0(
      title_text, "\n",
      "NES=", round(NES_val, 2),
      " | padj=", signif(padj_val, 2)
    )) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 22, 10)
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = lab_df_thin,
      aes(x = rank, y = label_y, label = symbol),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      angle = angle,
      vjust = 0,
      hjust = 0,
      size = text_size,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
}

# 8.6. Final publication plotting settings (as supplied).
p1 <- make_plot_with_thinned_tick_labels(
  pathway_genes = pw1_genes,
  pathway_key = "DDX58/IFIH1-mediated induction of IFN-α/β",
  title_text = "DDX58/IFIH1-mediated induction of IFN-α/β",
  fg = fg,
  ranks_sig = ranks_sig,
  label_mode = "allHits",
  min_gap = 100,
  max_labels = 50,
  label_y_frac = 0.12,
  angle = 90,
  text_size = 4.0
)

p2 <- make_plot_with_thinned_tick_labels(
  pathway_genes = pw2_genes,
  pathway_key = "ISG15 antiviral mechanism",
  title_text = "ISG15 antiviral mechanism",
  fg = fg,
  ranks_sig = ranks_sig,
  label_mode = "allHits",
  min_gap = 100,
  max_labels = 50,
  label_y_frac = 0.12,
  angle = 90,
  text_size = 4.0
)

p1 / p2



```
